provenance.structure: Field names, types and values read from the AcroForm dictionary with pdf-lib and cross-checked against the generator source (scripts/generate-corpus.ts, PDF-07).
provenance.geometry: Field bounds are the widget /Rect stored in the PDF. They are 0.5pt larger on every side than the generator's requested rectangle (150,710,250x24) because pdf-lib adds half the border width.
provenance.text: Title and the two labels are PDFium text objects; field values are NOT page text objects (they are widget annotations).

uncertain.what: Which label belongs to which field.
uncertain.why: The PDF has no tagging linking them. The pairing is by position only: each label sits immediately left of its field on the same line (label baselines y=720 and y=660, field rects spanning y=709.5-734.5 and y=649.5-674.5).

limitations: Field values live in widget annotations, so PDFium page text objects (what the editor engine reads) do not include 'John Doe' or 'john@example.com'.
Forms are an unsupported editing surface in LayahTools today (see root CLAUDE.md): the editor model does not represent AcroForm widgets, so nothing in the Layah model corresponds to these fields.
Only text fields are present; checkboxes, radio groups, dropdowns and signatures are not covered by this fixture.
Single page: header/footer and page-number detection cannot apply.
